notes:
### Added
- Resize by dragging: the selected model shows grips: red (width), green
  (depth), blue (height) in the middle of its sides and a dark one on the
  top corner (uniform). Drag a grip to resize; a dashed box shows the new
  size with live dimensions (also in the Measurements box). Shift while
  dragging keeps proportions, Esc cancels, and each drag is one undo step.
  Typing sizes still works.
- Core::DragMath: grip position from the mouse ray (closest point between
  the grip line and the ray), tested.
